_comment: Pages the draft-update workflow reads (scripts/draft-update.mjs). Edit freely: name is shown as the source in flood.json; followLinks (0-4) opens that many flood-related article links found on the page, so each change can cite an article with its own publication time. Sources that can't be fetched are listed in the pull request.

sources.name: Thai Meteorological Department (warnings)
sources._note: TMD open-data warnings feed, using the demo key from TMD's API documentation (register your own at data.tmd.go.th). The tmd.go.th website itself sends an incomplete certificate chain, which Node rejects.
